Read a raw 10x matrix in a streaming pass, keeping only the cells.

Source: R/io_stream.R
read_10x_streaming.Rd

Reads matrix.mtx(.gz) in chunks, twice: first to total each barcode, then to keep the cells' entries and reduce the empty droplets to a soup_summary(). Neither the raw matrix nor the empty-droplet matrix is ever held in memory; peak memory is the cells plus one chunk. Cells and empties are defined as in split_droplets().

Usage

read_10x_streaming(
  dir,
  cells = NULL,
  cell_min_umi = 500,
  empty_umi_range = c(1, 100),
  gene_column = 1,
  feature_type = "Gene Expression",
  chunk_lines = 2e+06
)

Arguments

dir

a Cell Ranger raw_feature_bc_matrix directory (matrix.mtx, features.tsv or genes.tsv, barcodes.tsv; optionally gzipped).

cells

optional character vector of cell barcodes (recommended).

cell_min_umi

used only when cells is NULL.

empty_umi_range

inclusive UMI range for empty droplets.

gene_column, feature_type

as in read_10x_counts().

chunk_lines

matrix entries read per chunk.

Value

list(cells = genes x cells dgCMatrix, soup = a decant_soup, summary = the same counts as split_droplets()).
